items.title: AI项目/创业探讨
items.description: 作为字节大模型2B落地第一线的参与者和观察者，我曾深度参与多个项目的设计/发展，帮助其将大模型落地到实际业务中。服务过的客户涵盖传统行业龙头，AI Native创业公司，互联网公司，泛体制内机构等；如果你对AI感兴趣，或者有任何有趣的点子，抑或是创业的想法，随时欢迎与我交流！

items.title: 技术支持
items.description: 一些代码上的技术问题，也许我也可以帮到你。虽然谈不上技术专家，但涉猎比较广，参与过多家大厂核心业务开发并上线。

items.title: AI Projects / Startup Discussions
items.description: As a frontline participant and observer of ByteDance's B2B large model deployment, I've been deeply involved in the design and development of multiple projects, helping integrate large models into real-world business scenarios. Clients I've served span traditional industry leaders, AI-native startups, internet companies, and public-sector organizations. If you're interested in AI, have any cool ideas, or are thinking about starting something — feel free to reach out anytime!

items.title: Technical Support
items.description: I may also be able to help with coding and technical questions. While I wouldn't call myself a deep specialist, I have broad exposure and have contributed to core product development at several major tech companies.
